name: Cyanobacteria
desc: Films of algae coat stones and tufa in the lakes and streams and are grazed by insect larvae and small crustaceans.
about: Cyanobacteria ( sy-AN-oh-bak-TEER-ee-ə) are a group of autotrophic gram-negative bacteria of the phylum Cyanobacteriota that can obtain biological energy via oxygenic photosynthesis.
